# #682 — [cutover-should-fix] Capture pipeline lower-severity findings: typo'd health namespace green forever; empty OBSERVATION_ENABLED disables silently; chunked delivery vs Stop deadline; latch stuck-degraded; unhealed lanes still accruing

Found by the two pre-cutover capture audits (2026-08-09). The lower-severity capture findings, grouped. None independently controller-verified beyond the audits' own live probes — flagged for the owning lane to reproduce red-first. Truth grammar per item.

## SHOULD-FIX / cutover-relevant

1. **Typo'd OPENBRAIN_CAPTURE_HEALTH_NAMESPACE reads green forever** (liveness-observer.ts:391-403,:257). Unset is loud (correct). But a MISSPELLED namespace passes the !=="" check, queries a namespace with no rows, hits `if rows.length===0 return undefined` -> no capture block, /health green, indefinitely. Proven read-only: namespace='typo-namespace' over 360min returns 0 group rows vs 2 for rico. Same shape as total capture death: both indistinguishable from "quiet night" (tested/deliberate, liveness-observer.test.ts:80-87, "absence is not staleness", no time-based escalation). CUTOVER ACTION: verify the deployed OPENBRAIN_CAPTURE_HEALTH_NAMESPACE value exactly before cutover — a typo is invisible. Consider distinguishing "namespace has never had rows" (likely misconfig) from "namespace went quiet".

2. **Empty OPENBRAIN_OBSERVATION_ENABLED silently disables the observation lane** (config.py:580 — _empty_opt_in_means_unset NOT bound to ObservationSettings.enabled though it IS bound to allow_insecure_http/development_root; wrapper openbrain-hook-env:157 passes it unconditionally in env -i). Proven: ENABLED='' -> ValidationError; masked on this host (env sets it len=1). Blast radius bounded: loaded_observation() swallows separately (stop.py:299-307), so memory capture survives, only Langfuse observation is lost. Same defect class as #544 re-armed on the field that didn't get the fix. Not memory loss.

3. **Chunked delivery can exceed the 5s Stop deadline** (deliver.py:128-130; budget session.py:140). CAPTURE_LIFECYCLE_REQUESTS=5 assertion assumes "one write", but deliver.py loops one 0.7s-timeout call per SERVER_BATCH chunk with no elapsed check. Measured on a real 16.8MB transcript: 1,784 turns -> 18 calls -> 12.6s worst-case vs 5.0s deadline / 10s kill. Reachable only on from-zero re-read (replaced file / offset>size), not steady state — watermark advances only after all chunks, so a mid-loop kill re-reads safely (durability intact, repeated failure only). MEDIUM.

4. **Outage latch can stick degraded with no recovery** (outage.py; stop.py:172). Live latch: one row degraded=1 announced=1 for 22h; note_delivered fires only on a delivery for that session_key, and an ended session never Stops again, so the recovery bookend never emits. No DELETE FROM capture_outage anywhere. Per-session (new session starts healthy), so LOW, but a degraded announcement can never clear for a dead session.

## SHOULD-FIX / process

5. **Unhealed lanes are still accruing, not resolving** — ledger 29(3) "stays lazy" assumed 2,011 resolving on touch; measured now 2,777 in the unhealed shape (agent set, source/channel_id/server_id NULL), +245 on 08-08, +7 on 08-09. establishExactStartScope returns early (session-lifecycle.ts:67) when scope incomplete, so incomplete-scope clients keep creating them. NOT a capture-loss path (ob_raw_turns.lane_id is NULL on all 74,932 rows — capture keys on session_ref, verified), so the lazy ruling is safe FOR CAPTURE, but the premise ("2,011, resolving") is factually stale. Operator may want to revisit.

6. **No automated check drives the observer's gatherer SQL** — 656 driver states it doesn't; liveness-observer.test.ts uses a fake pool; no .pg.test.ts in server/capture/. A column rename or namespace-predicate regression passes every check and returns undefined forever (health green, capture unobserved). This is the coverage gap behind #680/#681 both surviving to production. Add a Postgres-backed test of the gatherer.

## NOTE
- silenceSeconds takes MIN across roles (liveness-observer.ts:250-251), masking a stale speaker behind a fresh one (probed [13s,20000s] reports 13); reported-only, never thresholded, so misleads an operator rather than gating wrong.
- A .ts done-means driver run under bash (wrong interpreter) prints errors and EXIT=0 — executing nothing, reporting success. Add a bun/shebang guard so a CI lane with the wrong interpreter can't get a vacuous green.
